description: This header file provides utility functions and templates for managing smart pointers, including creation, conversion, and traits, as part of the Abseil C++ library's memory utilities.

classes.name: memory_internal::ExtractOr
classes.description: A template struct that evaluates to a specific type based on whether an extraction template can be applied to a given object.

classes.name: memory_internal::GetIsNothrow
classes.description: A template alias that retrieves the 'is_nothrow' trait from an allocator.

classes.name: absl::allocator_is_nothrow
classes.description: A traits class that determines if an allocator's allocation function never throws.

methods.name: WrapUnique
methods.description: Wraps a raw pointer into a std::unique_ptr, disallowing array types.

methods.name: make_unique
methods.description: Creates a std::unique_ptr with perfect forwarding of constructor arguments.

methods.name: RawPtr
methods.description: Extracts the raw pointer from a pointer-like object.

methods.name: ShareUniquePtr
methods.description: Converts a std::unique_ptr into a std::shared_ptr, transferring ownership.

methods.name: WeakenPtr
methods.description: Creates a std::weak_ptr from a std::shared_ptr.
